description: Get the median (p50) yearly total compensation in USD for a job family in each of up to 5 locations, across all levels, from submissions in the last 12 months. Pass every location you are comparing in one call. This is the figure to quote for a location's pay; get-location-stats ranks locations over a longer window, so its medians can differ. For one company's pay by level, use get-salaries-by-company-level instead. Free limit: Median (p50) total compensation for one job family in up to 5 locations per call. No other percentiles, sample size, level split, or company, focus area or funding filters. Pass canonical slugs (jobFamilySlug, locationSlug(s), countrySlug, companySlug(s)): resolve names first with search-job-families, search-locations and search-companies; never guess a slug. REQUIRED arguments: jobFamilySlug, locationSlugs. Array-typed arguments (locationSlugs) must be passed as arrays, even for a single value.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

locationSlugs.description: Up to 5 location slugs (metro, country or region; not a state or city), compared in one call. Resolve each with search-locations first; for a city, use its parent metro, and for a state, its metro or country.

name: get-salary-percentiles
